notes.title: New Translation Update
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you,

Today the game is upgraded to version 0.05d.
I hope you will enjoy this new update! Read below for all the details.

This update mainly contains the addition of six new translations for Demelia's Isle.

- German
- Spanish
- Portuguese (Brazilian)
- Polish
- Dutch
- Italian

-Fixed: the objects in the inventory was only displayed in French. (This is the default language).
-Fixed: Various minor bugs.

Good game to all.

notes.title: Food & Drink Update
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you,

Today the game is upgraded to version 0.05
I hope you will enjoy this new update! Read below to get all the details.
WARNING !! This update makes your old saves obsolete. Sorry for the inconvenience.

-Changed: Modification of the player physics to limit as much as possible the collisions with objects in the world.
-Added : The notions of hunger and thirst are implemented with the new game features that go with it.
-Added : Harvestable vegetables appear in the map allowing you to eat, as well as at the merchants.
-Added : In the inventory, the U key allows you to eat/drink from a gourd or a potion.
-Added : Some rivers or water points are now drinkable and allow to fill the gourd. Other rivers are not. But if you swim in the sea or other water points, it will slowly rehydrate you. Beware there are non-drinkable water sources.
Modification: the secondary attack of the two-handed sword has been modified.
-Added : The hammer now has a secondary attack.
Changed : The stamina management has been changed and fixed when using two-handed weapons.
-Added: DOT Bleeding has been added.
-Added: Drinking a health potion now removes the current DOT.

-Changed: The IU has been reworked to be more readable.

-Fixed: Synchronization of object settings for different languages is now fixed.
-Fixed: Various bugs.

-Added : Steam cloud is now available.

-Added the "Alpha_Test" Zone in public for people who would like to access the latest updates before uploading them in the branch. Warning : this zone is available at your own risk.


Good game to all.

notes.title: Camera Update
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you,

Today the game is upgraded to version 0.04c.1203

I hope you will enjoy this new update! Read below for full details.

-Fix: the platform going up to one of the pylons in the dream space doesn't bug anymore.
-Fix: [Multiplayer] arrows fired by clients were not doing damage.
-Fix: Various bugs.

-Add : [IA] Archers Type Enemies are now implemented.
-Add : A campfire has been added in the demon arena.

-Change: Change in the physics of the arrows
-Change: [AI] Improved AI for remote combat
-Change: Removed the appearance change in the menu. The customization of the appearance is done at the launch of a new game or from a campfire.
-Change: You can cancel an archery by doing [Mouse Right].
-Change: Added/changed visuals/translations.
-Change : Added and modified background music.
-Change : To follow up on a number of returns and the problems generated when aiming with the bow, I modified the player camera. I hope you will like this new version.

Good game to all.

notes.title: Weapons update
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you,

Today the game is upgraded to version 0.04

[h3]Even if the game doesn't force you to start a new game, I recommend you to do it to take full advantage of the new features.[/h3]

I hope you will enjoy this new update! Read below for full details.

-Add: [New Weapons] Axes (One Hand) added
-Add: [New Weapons] Hammers (Two Hands) have been added
-Add: [New Weapons] Spears ((Two Hands) have been added
-Add: [New Weapons] Bows ((Two Hands) have been added
-Add: 12 New Skills are available 
-Add: Added new sub-missions

-Change: Rebalancing the consumption of stamina
-Change: Better visibility of critical shots
-Change: [IA] Rebalancing and Added Sound Detection Levels. 
-Change: [IA] Howling Enemies warn their Friends nearby.
-Change: [Multiplayer] Optimized network synchronization.

-Fix: Boss/Elites can no longer be overturned.
-Fix: Various Bugs...

Good game to all.

notes.title: Update 0.03c
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you,

Today the game is upgraded to version 0.03c.1116a.
I hope you will enjoy this new update! Read below for full details.

-Change: Bosses can no longer be interrupted.
-Change: The player's combat system has been reworked.
-Change: Dodges are faster and can be repeated more often.
-Change: Some of the player's animations have been changed.
-Change: Drinking a potion is faster.
-Change: Tips have been added and some modifications to existing tips have been made.

-Fix: The favorite care potion is now correctly registered.
-Fix: Fixed/improved/deleted some objects due to problems with unwanted collisions in the game.
-Fix: Various minor bugs.
-Fix: Fireballs no longer hit allied players.

-Add : 5 New Skills are available.
-Add: In the Quests interface, you can click on the images to zoom in and out.

Good game to all.

notes.title: Update 0.03b
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you,

Today the game is upgraded to version 0.03b.
I hope you will enjoy this new update! Read below for all the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38422526/ea1b3478047af308fee0630923144e09dd6eb8cb.jpg[/img]

-Added : Tips are now displayed when the character is progressing
-Changed: The loot rates of rare objects have been modified.
-Changed: Some Equipment Icons have been added and/or modified.
-Added : A new dungeon has been added. 
-Added : New steps in the main quest have been added.
-Added : In the quest interface, you can now zoom in on images by clicking on them.
-Fixed [Multiplayer]: Pylon activation is now shared between all players.
-Fixed [Multiplayer]: Mobile platforms are now synchronized between players.


[b]Important note for players who completed the main quest in the previous version:[/b]

[i]Your progress in the quests will not have been modified, but to continue the story, you will have to go back through the portal in the Galios tower and redo the Jumping puzzle[/i] .

Good gameplay to all.

notes.title: Update 0.02
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you,

Today the game is upgraded to version [b]0.02[/b].

[h2][b]This update makes the old saves obsolete. Your whole progress will be reset. [/b][/h2]

I hope you are enjoying the new update ! Read below for all the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38422526/d8b8d28770b6e917a293815505b5c45496cafdf7.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Added/Modified: All equipment type objects (Armor, Weapon, Bag etc....) can now have different quality levels. Unusual (Green) / Rare (Blue) / Epic (Purple) / Legendary (Orange) that bring bonuses.
[*]Change: Mighty enemies can give more than one object.
[*]Added: Now the different objects placed (like potions or gold coins for example) in the world and the dungeons don't reappear anymore when reloading scenes.
[*]Added: The possibility to have a third Weapon is now possible. Two-handed sword added.
[/list]

You can find the update history [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1260910/discussions/0/2966141980977574903/]here[/url].

Have a good game !
